<?php
final class Order_Address_Editor {
    public function preview( WC_Order $order, array $shipping ) {
        $edited = clone $order;
        $edited->set_address( $shipping, 'shipping' );
        return $this->review_notice( $order, $edited );
    }

    private function review_notice( WC_Order $before, WC_Order $after ) {
        $notice = 'yes' === $after->get_meta( '_copy_billing_to_shipping' )
            ? __( 'Billing and shipping edits are linked.', 'woocommerce' )
            : __( 'Billing and shipping edits are independent.', 'woocommerce' );
        return array( 'notice' => $notice, 'shipping_changed' => false );
    }
}

// Colocated review-fixture tests activate only under an already loaded WC unit-test bootstrap.
if ( class_exists( 'WC_Unit_Test_Case', false ) ) {

/** Regression coverage for previewed shipping changes. */
class OrderAddressEditorTest extends WC_Unit_Test_Case {
    public function test_linked_unchanged() { $this->assert_preview( 'yes', false ); }
    public function test_linked_changed() { $this->assert_preview( 'yes', true ); }
    public function test_independent_unchanged() { $this->assert_preview( 'no', false ); }
    public function test_independent_changed() { $this->assert_preview( 'no', true ); }

    private function assert_preview( $linked, $changed ) {
        $order = new WC_Order();
        $order->set_address( array( 'city' => 'Colombo', 'postcode' => '00100' ), 'shipping' );
        $order->update_meta_data( '_copy_billing_to_shipping', $linked );
        $original = $order->get_address( 'shipping' );
        $requested = $original;
        if ( $changed ) { $requested['postcode'] = '20000'; }

        $actual = ( new Order_Address_Editor() )->preview( $order, $requested );

        $this->assertSame( $original, $order->get_address( 'shipping' ) );
        $this->assertSame( $changed, $actual['shipping_changed'] );
        $this->assertSame(
            'yes' === $linked
                ? __( 'Billing and shipping edits are linked.', 'woocommerce' )
                : __( 'Billing and shipping edits are independent.', 'woocommerce' ),
            $actual['notice']
        );
    }

}
}
